title: A Paradox — the clean man who gathers the ashes becomes unclean
summary: 'A Paradox' slide with a second statement added: the clean priest who does the sacrifice becomes unclean, and the clean man who gathers the ashes becomes unclean. 'clean', 'priest', 'ashes' and 'unclean' are colour-coded.

text.text: The clean priest who does the sacrifice becomes unclean.
The clean man who gathers the ashes becomes unclean.

keywords: the paradox of the red heifer
purifying the unclean defiles the clean
